text: Program Description Tuition: 14500 Yuan/RMB/the fall semester 19350 Yuan/RMB/the spring semester Introduction: Tongji University is one of the first universities to undertake the Pre-University education of Chinese government scholarship undergraduate students in China, and at the same time recruit self funded preparatory students. Located in Siping Road Campus of Tongji University, the Pre-University department for foreign students of Tongji University, Ministry of education, has a teaching building with Chinese traditional architectural characteristics, modern teaching facilities such as multimedia classroom, special classroom, lecture hall, electronic reading room, Chinese culture classroom, and a team of full-time teachers of Chinese, physics, mathematics and chemistry. All the teachers have graduate degree or above, and the teachers are strong enough to fully meet the needs of Pre-University education. At present, the Pre-University Department has nearly 80 countries of Chinese government scholarship undergraduate preparatory students and some self funded students in school. They will systematically study general Chinese, professional Chinese, mathematics, physics, chemistry and other basic courses, and participate in various forms of school activities, such as language and culture activities around teaching, Experience of China activities, etc. As one of the most famous universities in China, Tongji University’s international student Pre-University “bridge course” is connected with China's famous universities. According to the characteristics of international students, the preparatory course “bridge course” helps students quickly master the learning methods of China’s famous universities, adapt to the undergraduate learning life in advance, shorten the adaptation period of studying abroad, and finally smoothly enter the dream university suitable for themselves to study undergraduate major.
